basics.name: Robert Townsend
basics.label: Forward Deployed Engineer — AI Solutions
basics.summary: Forward Deployed Engineer who embeds with customers to design, build, and ship production AI solutions end to end — LLM agents, RAG systems, and MCP integrations. 15+ years across the full stack, deploying software into live customer environments from nationwide HIPAA telehealth to AWS products used by millions. I turn ambiguous business problems into working systems, and I'm equally at home aligning stakeholders and going deep on agent orchestration, cloud infrastructure, and application code.
